summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in tensorlake@0.5.160
details: Analysis of the published tarball for tensorlake@0.5.160 surfaced no indicators of installer-side harm. No install-time lifecycle scripts fetch or execute remote content; no code reads installer credential paths such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, or browser secret stores; no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, obfuscated destinations, dropper staging, or backdoor listeners were observed; and no silent-relay of caller-supplied data to a non-first-party destination is present. The package behaves as an ordinary npm library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
